source_revision: patched: margin scan skips joint names containing '_hand_' (14 hand joints); arm/waist joints still checked. Source re-registered from work/ll_v3/substrate/safety_guard.py, unmodified by the validator.
contract: config warmup.substrate[safety_guard]: joint margin, base tilt, penetration; aborts or flags before a limit. Delegated contract adds: never commands.
micro_benchmark_gate: (1) normal state: safety_guard {} returns ok=true, reporting base_tilt_deg, joint_margin_min, penetration_max. (2) forced violation (margin < 0.05, base tilt > 8 deg, or penetration > 2 mm): safety_guard returns abort=true with the violation named.

read_only.mechanism: run() only calls api.base_state(), api.joint_ranges() and api.contact_detail(limit=200); no command/step/act call.
read_only.evidence: probe state before and after the normal-state guard call is identical: t=0.0, base=[0.0, 0.0, 0.793], object at [1.731, 0.03, 0.8], hands [0.18, 0.154, 0.888] / [0.18, -0.154, 0.888].

joint_margin.mechanism: scans api.joint_ranges() excluding joint names containing '_hand_' (14 skipped, 17 checked); margin = min(q-lo, hi-q); worst margin compared to joint_margin_min (default 0.05).

penetration.mechanism: contact_detail(); any contact with dist < -penetration_tol (default 2 mm) is recorded; max |dist| over pairs must exceed 2 mm to violate.

guard_inspection.binding_constraint_definition: first entry of violations in precedence order

notes: Both micro-benchmark cases pass after the patch: normal reset state ok=true with no violations; forced qp_reach state abort=true with joint_margin and penetration named.
Normal-state worst scanned joint is now waist_roll_joint at 0.52 rad; the 10 finger joints seated at q=0.0 on a range bound are excluded by the '_hand_' skip.
The arm joint check is preserved: the forced state still detects right_elbow_joint at -0.0800 rad, so the 0.05 rad rule still guards the joints the primitives command.
Read-only verified again: probe state before and after the guard call is identical.

Documented scope change: hand-joint range excursions are no longer surfaced by this guard. Accepted because the hand joints are commanded to targets by hand_close_contact/hand_open and rest at their bounds by design; the guard now measures the commanded arm/waist joints.

Revision history: the first registration (unpatched source scanning all 31 joints) aborted at the reset state with joint_margin_min=0.0 at left_hand_index_0_joint (verdict restrict). That raw evidence remains in work/ll_v3/reports/w1_validator_raw/ files 01-09 and this report's prior version.
